title: Recovered work
originalRequest: Create a responsive tide and swell forecasting dashboard for surfers that integrates real-time marine meteorological data feeds to provide wave characteristics, wind vectors, and tidal heights.
latestMessage: Create a responsive tide and swell forecasting dashboard for surfers that integrates real-time marine meteorological data feeds to provide wave characteristics, wind vectors, and tidal heights.

steps.title: Integrate NDBC Buoy Data Feed
steps.instruction: Establish stable connections to the National Data Buoy Center API to extract wave height, dominant period, and swell direction for selected regional buoys.
steps.acceptance: The backend service must successfully parse buoy XML payloads and cache the structured marine metrics on a 30-minute refresh cycle.

steps.title: Implement Harmonic Tide Prediction Model
steps.instruction: Develop the calculation service to compute hourly tide heights and identify high/low tide peaks using harmonic constants for designated coastal stations.
steps.acceptance: Calculated tide heights must deviate by less than 5% from official CO-OPS astronomical predictions for the same station coordinate.

steps.title: Build Wind-Swell Correlation Engine
steps.instruction: Program an analysis module that classifies wind direction relative to beach orientation to determine clean (offshore) or blown-out (onshore) conditions.
steps.acceptance: The system must correctly tag conditions as Clean, Choppy, or Blown-out based on local wind vectors and coastline angles.

steps.title: Develop Interactive Tide Graph and Forecast UI
steps.instruction: Construct a responsive web dashboard using a charting library to visualize tide heights, swell periods, and wind velocities over a rolling 7-day period.
steps.acceptance: The chart must display an overlay of current time, render correctly on mobile screens, and update dynamically when a user switches surf locations.

steps.title: Implement Geolocation and Favorite Spots Module
steps.instruction: Create a client-side geolocation search to locate nearest surf breaks and allow users to save preferred spots to local storage.
steps.acceptance: The dashboard must load the nearest break automatically on first visit and maintain a persistent list of saved locations in the browser session.
